Thai syllable dictionary from the PyThaiNLP project.
Source: https://github.com/PyThaiNLP/pythainlp/blob/dev/pythainlp/corpus/syllables_th.txt
Downloaded: 2026-11-23. Apache License 2.0 (see PyThaiNLP-LICENSE.txt).
syllables-th.txt is retained as downloaded. ../syllables.js is an adapted JavaScript representation filtering entries to Thai characters; it is generated by NaviBay train.cjs.
